corrected_prompt:
STYLE: Stop-motion clay puppet scene - clay characters detailed with tiny craft materials: thread-wrapped hair, fabric details, wire accents, on a fully sculpted clay set, cinematic stop-motion film lighting with gentle shadows, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the puppet world. Palette: warm cream, terracotta and mustard clay with deep teal shadows, warm amber light; one bright subject against a calm, plain clay wall.

FORMAT AND LAYOUT: one vertical 9:16 image (portrait, 9 wide by 16 tall). Positions are fractions of the frame from the top-left corner. The top 30% of the frame is only plain clay wall, empty, kept clear for words added later. The main subject sits between 30% and 84% down. Nothing important in the bottom 16% or the right 13% of the frame, except the plank tip and the bare page edge at the right end of the seesaw.

SUBJECT, THE SEESAW: one clay seesaw seen side on, centred, spanning from 6% to 94% of the frame width, between 40% and 84% down. A terracotta clay plank rests on the top point of a mustard clay triangle pivot at 50% across and 62% down. The seesaw is tipped hard to the left: the left end touches the floor at about 80% down, the right end is high in the air at about 40% down.
On each end of the plank lies a calendar month page sculpted from flat cream clay with a stitched fabric border and a stitched grid of empty day squares.
THE LEFT, LOW END: its page is crowded with about ten little clay client figures, each about the height of a thumb, standing on the page with their feet on it, their weight holding that end down. They are simple adult business people in tiny fabric jackets and trousers, thread-wrapped hair, simple eyes with white sclera and dark pupils, mixed skin tones, standing and chatting, calm and pleased.
THE RIGHT, HIGH END: its page is completely bare, nobody and nothing on it.

SETTING: one plain warm cream clay wall fills the background, a plain clay floor meets the wall at 84% down; warm amber light from the upper left, gentle deep teal shadows low down. No window, shelf, desk or other objects. Camera at the height of the pivot, side on. Medium wide shot of the whole seesaw.

Must also not include: no figure or object on the high right end's calendar page (the page itself belongs there); one seesaw only.

HANDS: no human hands, fingers or arms anywhere in the picture.

TEXT: none. No text, letters, numbers or words anywhere in the picture: not on the calendar, the wall or any object. The calendar's day squares are empty stitched squares with no numbers, and there is no month name.

CAMERA: macro miniature-set look, about 50mm, shallow depth of field, the main subject sharp; the camera sits inside the miniature clay world.

DO NOT INCLUDE: no text, letters, numbers or words; no hearts, likes, thumbs-up, follower counts, notification badges, social media icons or logos; no real platform names, logos or app screens; no phone screens; no extra subjects beyond those named; no clutter in the top third; no smooth, glossy or CGI-looking surfaces; no motion blur; no borders, frames, split screens, set edges, workbench or the room around the miniature set.

Everything in frame is real modeling clay, photographed - visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
